title: Designing Customer Feedback for Subscription Boxes
abstract: arXiv:2610.34726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Problem definition: Subscription box services often ask customers for ratings before choosing what to send. Responses are scarce, and longer questionnaires and finer scales lower completion. We study which candidate items a questionnaire should ask about, and in what format, when the platform then selects a fixed number of them. A design is judged by the expected value lost by not selecting the truly best items. Methodology/results: We approximate each ordinal rating by a Gaussian signal carrying its information at the cutoff between selected and unselected items. As equal numbers of responses per item grow, the ratio of this proxy's loss to the exact loss tends to one. With 1 to 100 responses per item, the two are within about 7 percent. Averaging the information over the prior instead can misstate the loss by about half. translated_title: 订阅盒服务的客户反馈问卷设计
translated_abstract: 问题定义：订阅盒服务通常在选择发送什么商品之前，先请客户对候选商品进行评分。客户回复数据稀缺，而更长的问卷和更细的评分量表会降低完成率。我们研究在平台随后需从候选中选出固定数量商品的情形下，问卷应询问哪些候选商品以及采用何种形式；设计的优劣以未选中真正最优商品所损失的期望价值来衡量。方法/结果：我们用一个高斯信号来近似每个序数评分，该信号在入选与未入选商品的临界点处携带相应信息。当每件商品的回复数量相同且增加时，该代理方法的损失与精确损失之比趋于1；在每件商品1至100条回复的范围内，两者相差约在7%以内。相比之下，若将信息量在先验分布上取平均，则可能使损失估计的偏差达约一半。对于远离临界点的商品，回复的价值起初增长缓慢、随后加速，因此我们的包络规则……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 针对订阅盒服务的反馈问卷设计问题，本文提出用高斯信号在入选临界点处近似序数评分所携带的信息，以量化因未选中真正最优商品而产生的期望价值损失，从而指导平台决定应询问哪些候选商品以及采用何种评分形式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes approximating each ordinal customer rating by a Gaussian signal carrying its information at the selection cutoff, enabling subscription-box platforms to design feedback questionnaires—which items to ask about and in what format—that minimize the expected value lost by not selecting the truly best items.
